items.title: Ethereum, Altcoins See 'Outsized Drawdowns' Due to Macro Pressures
items.body: Market analysts say that macro factors are pushing altcoin prices down, after ETH, XRP, and SOL all dropped on the day.

items.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
items.body: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.

items.title: Babylon advances native Bitcoin lending proposal on Aave V4
items.body: Babylon’s proposal to bring native Bitcoin collateral to Aave V4 has entered a new governance stage, but further votes and security reviews remain before launch.

items.title: Starknet introduces wallet privacy feature for DeFi activity
items.body: Starknet’s Shadow Accounts allow users to obscure connections between their main wallets and DeFi activity, though transactions remain visible onchain.

items.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
items.body: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.

items.title: Bitmine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
items.body: Tom Lee said Bitmine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.
